component.name: NexZen
component.summary: Browse the web and mirror your Android phone side by side

description.p: NexZen is a Chromium-based desktop browser that works hand in hand with NexZen for Android: see and control your phone next to the page you are reading, and move links and files between devices.

ul.li: SuperMenu: every browser function one right-click away, right under the cursor
NexZen Mirror: mirror and control your Android phone with sound, over USB or Wi-Fi, end-to-end encrypted
NexShare: send links, text and files between phone and computer
Workspaces, incognito windows, per-site privacy and Custom CSS
